correctness.rationale: Every idempotent fixes its image pointwise, forcing an induced consecutive arc; the other arc is exactly a bounded nearest-neighbor path, with length constraint k≤n/2. This bijection establishes labeled counts. The dihedral stabilizer of an image arc has precisely 2 elements, and its action on path walks is w(t)→k-w(L-t); Burnside and a midpoint classification give exact fixed counts s and thus the unit-conjugacy polynomial. Path-resolvent determinant recurrence gives b coefficient and the reflection principle provides an independent binomial form. Odd cycles have only automorphism endomorphisms and hence only the identity idempotent. Direct full-graph homomorphism enumeration checked ranks n=3..16; independent full dihedral conjugation checked n=3..15; finite runs corroborate but are not the all-n proof.

value.rationale: Unit-conjugacy under Aut(C_n) is a natural invariant of the established cycle graph endomorphism monoid, distinct from Green relations and from counting all endomorphisms. The result gives complete, rank-resolved orbit counts for the entire family, not an arbitrary small case; the reflection-fixed correction reflects a nontrivial stabilizer and explains the symmetry quotient. It explicitly separates already known unrefined Dyck enumerations, avoiding claiming those numbers as original. It can inform algebraic classification of retracts and symmetry reduction without assuming a downstream theorem.
